findings.text_says: Question 7: "that inequality is proved to decide where the band that is read starts at or below that point, and its top is a level from which…" Three sentences on: "Under those conditions, a first reading … still corrects the rule, and it ends."
findings.lean_or_fact_says: `locked_turns_in_time_on_window_iff` has `low`, `covers` (`c ≤ K`, so the top is at or above such a level) and `safe` as premises. The text is true to it, but "decide where the band … starts" reads as deciding where the band starts, and "those conditions" now sits after two sentences on where the conditions fail, so it can be taken for them, where nothing is proved.
findings.proposed_wording: Where it sets the rule only, the same inequality is proved to settle it under two conditions on the band that is read: it starts at or below that point; and its top is at or above a level from which the level does not fall back under any rule, or is one the level never reaches after the reading. Under these two, a first reading that leaves the level below that point still corrects the rule, and what goes on ends all the same. Where the band starts above that point, a course can meet the inequality and still end (question 6's worked course). Whether the condition on the top is needed is not shown.

findings.text_says: Question 4: "the level at that step is below a need that was met at the start, and so below where it started, and it ends, at a step no theorem bounds."
findings.lean_or_fact_says: `way_ends` concludes a step at which no need is met; nothing says the level comes to nothing. The two edits put "it" (the level) next to "it ends", which now reads as the level ending.
findings.proposed_wording: …and so below the level it started from. With that premise what goes on also ends: at some step, which no theorem bounds, no need is met.

findings.text_says: "…offspring take more and need no more than their parent, every unit needs something, and the level has a ceiling with nothing given from nothing. Without the second of these the line can go on (`KidsNeedMore`)."
findings.lean_or_fact_says: `KidsNeedMore.all_but_down` drops `down` only. In the longer list "the second" can be counted as "every unit needs something". Item 5 says it plainly.
findings.proposed_wording: Without offspring needing no more than their parent the line can go on (`KidsNeedMore`).

findings.proposed_wording: Row 4: "the share times a positive amount". Row 5: "That each unit's kids together take exactly what it took". Row 7: "question 6's givens other than those on the share (nothing is given about the corrected rule staying), and:".

findings.text_says: "…hold with the stock taken out, which a test fixed beforehand named as nothing having changed." "The model says that a line once gone does not come back, and one case in which a loss changes nothing else".

findings.proposed_wording: "…hold with the stock taken out, an outcome fixed beforehand as one that would count as nothing having changed." "…does not come back, and gives one case in which a loss changes nothing else".
